zh: 看板下方菜单改成参考 gooey-plus-menu 的扇面：加号化开成三个图标动作，底色、桥接与投影由同一张 SVG goo 滤镜画出，展开按 40ms 错峰，收起时整块下沉 5px 再回弹。
en: The bottom menu now follows the gooey-plus-menu fan: the plus splits into three icon actions whose fill, bridges and shadow come from one SVG goo filter, with a 40 ms stagger on open and a 5 px dip before the close settles.
